name: MagicX XU Mini M

pad.from: derived: cfg + lab boot evidence (probe.txt) confirms the unit boots this cfg and that its pad answers at /dev/input/event3 in practice, not the literal device name
pad.note: xu10-joypad driver on Knulli's rk3326-magicx-mini-m.dtb. On the XU Mini M (2026-11-12) the volume keys came on rg351-keys, not here.

VOL_UP.note: on the XU Mini M the key arrives on rg351-keys (2026-11-12)

VOL_DOWN.note: on the XU Mini M the key arrives on rg351-keys (2026-11-12)

LEFT_STICK.from: measured: button-reader-XUMiniM-1.txt; button-reader-XUMiniM-2.txt; button-reader-XUMiniM-3.txt (XU Mini M runs 1-3, on the Mini Flip's card)
LEFT_STICK.note: axes read turned vs. the odroidgo3/singleadc family: X is STICK_RIGHT (axis 1), Y is STICK_DOWN (axis 0); cfg comment claims this was measured on hardware (see notes)
LEFT_STICK.cfg_differs: the cfg's STICK_DOWN="3 0" carries no sign; on hardware down reads negative (up positive, as the cfg's SDL map comment says)
LEFT_STICK.over_cfg: measured (2026-11-12); spruce keeps its cfg lines, so Button Reader expects and draws down as negative

RIGHT_STICK.from: measured: button-reader-XUMiniM-1.txt; button-reader-XUMiniM-2.txt; button-reader-XUMiniM-3.txt (XU Mini M runs 1-3, on the Mini Flip's card)
RIGHT_STICK.note: same turned convention as the left stick
RIGHT_STICK.cfg_differs: the cfg's STICK_DOWN_2="3 3" carries no sign; on hardware down reads negative (up positive, as the cfg's SDL map comment says)
RIGHT_STICK.over_cfg: measured (2026-11-12); spruce keeps its cfg lines, so Button Reader expects and draws down as negative

notes: XUMiniM.cfg's own header: "Pad and panel values are from Knulli's rk3326-magicx-mini-m.dtb; none of it has been read off a running unit yet." A lab unit (.82, hostname xumini) has since booted this exact cfg and run Saturn benchmarks (kit-minim), confirming the pad answers at event3 and the power key at event0, but no per-button press capture exists in this workspace.

Stick axes are swapped versus the A10 Mini/G350/RGB30 family: STICK_UP/DOWN read axis 0 and STICK_LEFT/RIGHT read axis 1 (reversed). The SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_MAP comment in the cfg says this was itself "measured on hardware," which conflicts with the file's own top header calling everything unverified; kept here as the more specific claim, but re-verify on a unit.
